description.en_US: Search Google for ranked web links, titles and snippets. Build source-backed research workflows in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Search Google News for headlines, publishers, dates and article links. Build topic briefings and news digests in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Search Google Images for image URLs, thumbnails, dimensions and source pages. Find visual references in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Search Google Shopping for products, merchants, price labels and offer links. Compare shopping result snapshots in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Find video results across websites with Google Video Search. Get titles, source links and available durations in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Find local businesses and places with addresses, ratings and available contact details. Build location shortlists in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Find YouTube videos by keyword and return up to 20 requested results with IDs and available metadata. Discover videos in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Request up to 700 YouTube search results with filters for larger video discovery tasks. Separate pricing applies through the paid FlashData API.
Read YouTube titles, descriptions, channel information, statistics and available chapters. Enrich video records in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Get existing YouTube subtitles with timestamps and full text, defaulting to automatic captions. Build cited video summaries in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Retrieve existing uploader-provided YouTube captions in a selected language. Get subtitle segments and full text in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Inspect Creative Commons license labels from YouTube video metadata. This does not grant training or reuse permission. Uses the paid FlashData API.
Read a YouTube channel profile and recent videos from an @handle. Compare channels and collect recent uploads in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Get YouTube autocomplete suggestions for a query prefix, language and region. Explore related topics in Dify with the paid FlashData API.
Deliver YouTube video or audio to your cloud storage. Submit once, then read job status and results in Dify. Paid FlashData API; customer storage required.
